page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.8xlarge is a local-storage-heavy server instance within the ecs.i3 family, configured with 32 virtual CPUs derived from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 2.5 GHz with hyperthreading enabled. The system features 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio, alongside a bundled 7679 GB local SSD storage volume and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. The underlying x86_64 architecture incorporates instruction sets including AVX-512, AES cryptography, and FMA, backed by a 35 MB L3 cache.

Benchmark evaluations indicate intermediate overall multi-threaded capacity alongside lower single-core execution speed. In single-threaded CPU benchmarks, stress-ng scored 1318.1 and single-threaded gzip compression reached 23.03 GB/sec, placing in the lower percentile. In contrast, multi-threaded tasks showed middle-tier performance, marked by a multi-core stress-ng score of 28119.47, a Geekbench multi-core rating of 10415.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 27316.39. Uncached memory read bandwidth recorded 113.07 GB/sec, with write bandwidth measuring 49.34 GB/sec.

Combining 7679 GB of local SSD capacity with 256.0 GB of memory makes the instance effective for data-dense workloads requiring high local IOPS. In data store benchmarks, the instance processed 28.0 million Redis SET operations per second and delivered a PassMark database score of 11139.32, with web serving throughput reaching 21.38 GB/sec. The integration of high-density local NVMe SSD storage directly into the hardware configuration provides strong qualitative cost efficiency for relational databases, NoSQL clusters, and large data ingestion tasks without requiring separate block storage attachments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.8xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by 32 vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz, paired with 256.0 GB of RAM and 7679 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, its x86_64 CPU architecture includes AVX-512, AES, and FMA extensions. Performance metrics demonstrate middle-tier multi-threaded capacity, including a stress-ng multi-core score of 28119.47 and a PassMark CPU score of 27316.39, while single-core metrics remain modest. High-volume data tests show 28.0 million Redis SET operations per second and 21.38 GB/sec static web throughput. With 8.0 GB RAM per core and extensive local SSD storage, this instance is structured for memory-dense and I/O-intensive workloads, including transactional databases, search indexes, and data processing engines.
